lessons.title: Verbos Irregulares
lessons.description: Estudia las tres formas de cada verbo antes de practicar

exercises.question: Hoy he comido mucho, pero la semana pasada no comí nada.
accepted: Today I have eaten a lot, but last week I ate nothing.
Today I've eaten a lot, but last week I ate nothing.

exercises.question: Esta semana he escrito tres cartas. El lunes no escribí ninguna.
accepted: This week I have written three letters. On Monday I wrote none.
This week I've written three letters. On Monday I wrote none.

exercises.question: Hoy hemos ido al cine. Ayer no fuimos a ningún sitio.
accepted: Today we have gone to the cinema. Yesterday we didn't go anywhere.
Today we've gone to the cinema. Yesterday we didn't go anywhere.

exercises.question: Esta semana he aprendido muchas palabras nuevas. La semana pasada no aprendí ninguna.
accepted: This week I have learnt many new words. Last week I learnt none.
This week I've learnt many new words. Last week I learnt none.

exercises.question: Hoy he visto una película muy buena. Ayer no vi nada interesante.
accepted: Today I have seen a very good film. Yesterday I saw nothing interesting.
Today I've seen a very good film. Yesterday I saw nothing interesting.

exercises.question: Esta tarde Lucas ha hecho los deberes. Esta mañana no hizo nada.
accepted: This afternoon Lucas has done his homework. This morning he didn't do anything.
This afternoon Lucas has done his homework. This morning he did nothing.

exercises.question: Hoy he tomado el autobús al colegio. Ayer lo tomé y llegué tarde.
accepted: Today I have taken the bus to school. Yesterday I took it and arrived late.
Today I've taken the bus to school. Yesterday I took it and arrived late.

exercises.question: Hoy he conocido a la nueva profesora. El año pasado no la conocí.
accepted: Today I have met the new teacher. Last year I didn't meet her.
Today I've met the new teacher. Last year I didn't meet her.

exercises.question: Hoy he llevado el uniforme del colegio. Ayer llevé ropa normal.
accepted: Today I have worn the school uniform. Yesterday I wore normal clothes.
Today I've worn the school uniform. Yesterday I wore normal clothes.

exercises.question: Esta semana le he enviado muchos mensajes. La semana pasada no le envié ninguno.
accepted: This week I have sent her many messages. Last week I sent her none.
This week I've sent her many messages. Last week I sent her none.

exercises.question: Hoy he perdido mis llaves. Ayer también las perdí.
accepted: Today I have lost my keys. Yesterday I lost them too.
Today I've lost my keys. Yesterday I lost them too.

exercises.question: Hoy he roto un vaso. Ayer rompí el plato.
accepted: Today I have broken a glass. Yesterday I broke the plate.
Today I've broken a glass. Yesterday I broke the plate.

exercises.question: Esta semana hemos volado a Londres. El año pasado volamos a París.
accepted: This week we have flown to London. Last year we flew to Paris.
This week we've flown to London. Last year we flew to Paris.

exercises.question: Hoy he puesto mis libros en la mochila. Ayer los puse en la mesa.
accepted: Today I have put my books in the backpack. Yesterday I put them on the table.

exercises.question: Esta tarde he cogido el autobús. Ayer no lo cogí y llegué tarde.
accepted: This afternoon I have caught the bus. Yesterday I didn't catch it and arrived late.
This afternoon I've caught the bus. Yesterday I didn't catch it and arrived late.

exercises.question: Hoy he dejado mi abrigo en el colegio. Ayer lo dejé en casa.
accepted: Today I have left my coat at school. Yesterday I left it at home.
Today I've left my coat at school. Yesterday I left it at home.

exercises.question: Esta semana he estado muy ocupado. La semana pasada estuve en casa todo el día.
accepted: This week I have been very busy. Last week I was at home all day.
This week I've been very busy. Last week I was at home all day.

exercises.question: Esta tarde hemos cortado el pastel juntos. Esta mañana lo cortó mamá sola.
accepted: This afternoon we have cut the cake together. This morning mum cut it alone.
This afternoon we've cut the cake together. This morning mum cut it alone.

exercises.question: Esta semana hemos construido una maqueta. El año pasado construimos una casita de madera.
accepted: This week we have built a model. Last year we built a little wooden house.
This week we've built a model. Last year we built a little wooden house.

exercises.question: Esta mañana he comprado un libro nuevo. Ayer compré un cuaderno.
accepted: This morning I have bought a new book. Yesterday I bought a notebook.
This morning I've bought a new book. Yesterday I bought a notebook.

exercises.question: Esta tarde he dibujado un retrato. Esta mañana dibujé un paisaje.
accepted: This afternoon I have drawn a portrait. This morning I drew a landscape.
This afternoon I've drawn a portrait. This morning I drew a landscape.

exercises.question: Hoy he bebido mucha agua. Ayer bebí zumo de naranja.
accepted: Today I have drunk a lot of water. Yesterday I drank orange juice.
Today I've drunk a lot of water. Yesterday I drank orange juice.

exercises.question: Hoy papá ha conducido hasta el colegio. Ayer condujo hasta el supermercado.
accepted: Today dad has driven to school. Yesterday he drove to the supermarket.

exercises.question: Esta semana he tenido mucha suerte. La semana pasada no tuve ninguna.
accepted: This week I have had a lot of luck. Last week I had none.
This week I've had a lot of luck. Last week I had none.

exercises.question: Hoy he oído una canción preciosa. Ayer oí un ruido extraño.
accepted: Today I have heard a beautiful song. Yesterday I heard a strange noise.
Today I've heard a beautiful song. Yesterday I heard a strange noise.

exercises.question: Este mes he guardado todos mis cromos. El mes pasado los perdí todos.
accepted: This month I have kept all my stickers. Last month I lost them all.
This month I've kept all my stickers. Last month I lost them all.

exercises.question: Siempre he sabido que eres muy listo. Ayer lo supe con certeza.
accepted: I have always known that you are very clever. Yesterday I knew it for sure.
I've always known that you are very clever. Yesterday I knew it for sure.

exercises.question: Hoy he leído dos capítulos del libro. Ayer no leí ninguno.
accepted: Today I have read two chapters of the book. Yesterday I didn't read any.
Today I've read two chapters of the book. Yesterday I didn't read any.
exercises.hint: read → read → read (¡misma forma, distinta pronunciación!)

exercises.question: Hoy he corrido cinco kilómetros. Ayer corrí solo dos.
accepted: Today I have run five kilometres. Yesterday I ran only two.
Today I've run five kilometres. Yesterday I ran only two.
Today I have run five kilometers. Yesterday I ran only two.
Today I've run five kilometers. Yesterday I ran only two.

exercises.question: Hoy he pensado en una buena idea. Ayer pensé en algo diferente.
accepted: Today I have thought of a good idea. Yesterday I thought of something different.
Today I've thought of a good idea. Yesterday I thought of something different.

exercises.question: Esta semana hemos ganado el partido. La semana pasada lo perdimos.
accepted: This week we have won the match. Last week we lost it.
This week we've won the match. Last week we lost it.

exercises.question: Esta tarde Lucas ha hecho una tarta. Esta mañana no hizo nada especial.
accepted: This afternoon Lucas has made a cake. This morning he didn't make anything special.
This afternoon Lucas has made a cake. This morning he made nothing special.

exercises.question: Hoy he conocido a muchos niños nuevos. Ayer no conocí a nadie.
accepted: Today I have met many new children. Yesterday I didn't meet anyone.
Today I've met many new children. Yesterday I didn't meet anyone.
